messages:
claire: opened a docs PR to tighten SOC2 audit-log wording, add migration mapping, and include SDK examples for exports/redaction. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/523
 tim: looks good. two quick asks: 1) clarify that exports are immutable snapshots and do not change TTLs; 2) explicitly state which roles can request exports/holds.
 claire: drafting: 'Exports are immutable snapshots taken at request time and do not modify the configured retention TTL for stored logs.' for roles: proposing 'Organization Admins and users assigned the Compliance role.'
 eli: +1. also add a tiny migration table for legacy -> new fields (user.email -> actor.email, event_type -> action.name, ts -> timestamp). customers asked for this when upgrading.
 legal-ops: wording mostly ok. replace the word 'permanent' with 'indefinite' where applicable. add a pointer to internal retention policy: https://internal/legal/retention-policy and a one-line legal-hold workflow note: 'Legal places a hold via the compliance portal; holds suspend deletion until released and all hold actions are auditable.'
 claire: switched to 'indefinite', added internal link and workflow sentence. added a 3-row table and a JSON example showing mapping. also fixed a broken anchor in CLI docs (/docs/cli#audit-export).
 tim: can you include an error example for PII redaction not configured? customers like to see failure modes.
 claire: added TypeScript example + error body: {"error":"redaction_not_configured","code":422}. snippet:
 ```ts
 // TS example
 await client.audit.export({tenantId: 'acme', start: '2024-01-01', end: '2024-06-30', redactPII: true});
 // error -> 422 {"error":"redaction_not_configured"}
 ```
 eli: nit: keep snake_case in Ruby snippets per style guide. also add note that export requests are recorded in the audit trail with requestor.id.
 claire: fixed Ruby params to snake_case, added audit note.
 doc-bot: PR 523 updated, link-check passed, staging build OK.
 claire: planning to merge tomorrow morning if legal-ops confirms. thanks all :sparkles:
